description: Budget Ledger: atomically reserves reported USD spend across a run and its sub-agents. Returns allow/warn/block, remaining budget, retry storms and spend velocity. Call judge first, then reserve immediately before spending; honor block. This is cooperative accounting, not payment enforcement. Root cap and parent are immutable. Children inherit the root cap (send the same cap). event_id is the authoritative idempotency key; a custom HTTP key cannot override it. New event_id per attempted action; same event_id and body replays without reserving twice. No refunds or cap resets. Warn reservations count as spend. Limits: USD, six decimals, cap at most 1000000. Three matching actions in 60 seconds allowed; fourth blocked. Velocity warning at ten attempts/minute or more than 25% of cap/minute; 80% usage warns. Use action to distinguish operations at a merchant. Stored: IDs, keyed fingerprints and amounts, not raw action/merchant. Records persist until the API key is deleted; keyless records have no automatic expiry. $0.002 per call; shared 3 free calls per UTC day without a key (daily private IP namespace), plus 10/day with a free key. Anonymous scopes rotate daily; use a key for a persistent ledger/chain. Send the same Bearer key plus a payment header to keep the same ledger/chain after the allowance runs out.
name: budget_ledger
